archive.catalogue_description: Hello This my first release of a map so if you find bugs pls message me over this topic . and sorry it requires T4M . This map is Standoff from Black ops 2 but in WAW as zombie version. IF TEXTURE IS BUGGED SET IT ON HIGH OR MEDIUM WHEN YOURE INGAME OPEN CONSOLE AND TYPE: “Devmap Standoff” SO YOU CAN PLAY IT ALONE Bo1 WALLWEAPONS HAVE NO TEXT BUT YOU CAN BUY THEM!!! I had no time to make a Trailer but I started it so I will give you that what i have started: https://youtu.be/u7E7fVNwK0s My Standoff version has some extra rooms and a walkable house that wasnt walkable before. Standoff includes Gympie6’s_perks and has some ported Bo1 Weapons (Scavanger, Mp5k, Galil and more). We even have some zombie bosses like the Goliath and the Hazmat. It has wallweapons (but not many and no bo1 wallweapons). Perklimit is 5!!! Btw if you have problems with the boss zombies find the PTRS! . Standoff has a custom main menu song and Screen and a EE song with 6 Teddybears that you have to shoot (Could be more or less Teddys correct me if Im wrong). But I wont show you photos where there are so you have to find them If you really struggle to find them they make sounds! I removed some weapons since they are too strong and because i have some bo1 weapons: Removed Weapons from Mystery Box: -Wunderwaffe -Magnum -Kar98k -M1A1 Carbine -PTRS (Wallweapon) -Molotov -DoubleBarrel -Bar -FG42 -MG42 ​(Sry ) -PPSH (Sry ) -Panzershrek Credits: NG ​, above all thank you so much for helping me so much Gympie6, T
